about: How to fit four rooms into 79 m²

A four-room apartment of up to 79 m² means compact rooms, and every metre has to work. Built-in wardrobes instead of free-standing ones, sliding doors, beds with storage and a floor-to-ceiling kitchen help here. We arrange the furniture in the project so every room keeps a passage and natural light.

For 65–79 m² apartments it often pays to combine the kitchen with the living room and keep two or three separate bedrooms. We check the options against the building's structure: we do not move load-bearing walls or wet zones.

Historic Podil means narrow streets and restrictions for freight transport, so we plan material deliveries in advance. Renovation rules in the building are usually set by the management company — we follow them.
For reference: developer — Kyivmiskbud, address — Kozhumiatska / Dehtiarna St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Podil Hrad cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 75 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
How can a four-room apartment be comfortable on a small area?
Through a well-thought-out layout and built-in furniture: floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, sliding doors, beds with drawers, a compact kitchen with an island. Everything is arranged in the project.
How do you deliver materials to Podil?
We plan deliveries around the narrow streets and the building's rules, and bring large items in at agreed hours.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
